model.description: Model identifier from the workspace model catalog (bring-your-own-model). The demo's simulator ignores this and uses scripted responses.

system_prompt.description: The agent's persona/instructions. Written fresh per the clean-room rule (AGENTS.md); never copied from another framework.

tools.description: Tool names available to this agent definition.

agent.description: Either a reference to a workspace agent, or an inline agent definition (the demo always inlines; nothing to reference).

agent_id.description: Reference to an existing agent by id (desktop/Team Workspace).

allowed_tools.description: Tool names this seat may call. Empty means none. In the demo every write tool is simulated (ADR-0015 §2).

role.description: This seat's role in the team run (e.g. 'lead researcher', 'fact checker'). Mode-specific semantics live in the compiler (Phase 3).

seat_key.description: Stable key for this seat within the team (e.g. researcher, critic).

context.description: Fixed context key-values handed to every seat (sample data in the demo).

expected_output.description: Human-readable declaration of what the run must produce.

guardrails.description: Policy/guardrail identifiers that apply to this run (evaluated by the tool-call firewall and approvals; never bypassed, ADR-0012 §4).

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the run's final output must validate against. Optional; when absent the output is free-form text.

description: The shared Team definition used by the desktop app, Team Workspace and the online demo (simulated). Single source of truth per ADR-0015. Field naming is snake_case to match the desktop; the demo adapts. Covers: REQ-PRE-010 (WP-0013 AC-2). Untested locally — see CI.

format_version.description: Semver of this format. Breaking changes bump the major version and arrive as a new work package (ADR-0015 §1).

id.description: UUID text, per ADR-0010/ADR-0014 portable type rules.

mode.description: Orchestration mode. All modes compile onto the one durable graph runtime (spec § Orchestration).

seats.description: Agent seats. seat_key is unique within the team.

workspace_id.description: Owning workspace. Present in desktop/Team Workspace; the demo uses its sample workspace id.

title: Lanesra OS Team format
